content: Most of the content on this website was produced by me. Unless stated otherwise, the content is shared under a [CC0](${cc0Url}) public domain dedication; i.e. it has no restrictions on modification and redistribution.

Some of the files under [**/files**](/files) are technically derivative works, for example recorded lecture notes or typeset note sheets. In such cases I have tried to acknowledge the original authors on the page linking to the files.
The files under [**/pacman**](/pacman) are archives that contain the corresponding copyright status inside them.

The website's code is is written by me and released under the [Unlicense](${UNLICENSE_URL}). The server-side code has a few small dependencies with permissive licenses. More details can be found on the website's [GitHub page](${projectUrl}).
Most icons are taken from the [BoxIcons project](${boxIconsUrl}) and are licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0](${cc4ByUrl}).
